title: Buffs for the right people

steps.say: You're a druid in a group: Gorrak the warrior, Seylin the mage and Thalia the priest. Two icons are up, both for Gorrak.
Thorns only helps whoever gets hit, so it's suggested for the tank. Stack Your Buffs read Gorrak's talents: 31 points in Protection.
One click casts Thorns on Gorrak, not on you.

expect.lua: (function() for i = 1, 40 do local a = C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDataByIndex('party1', i) if not a then return false end if a.spellId == 9910 then return true end end end)()

steps.say: No Thorns reminder for you or Seylin: neither of you tanks.
Mark of the Wild helps everyone. You, Seylin and Thalia have it; only Gorrak is missing it.

expect.lua: (function() for i = 1, 40 do local a = C_UnitAuras.GetAuraDataByIndex('party1', i) if not a then return false end if a.spellId == 9885 then return true end end end)()

steps.say: Everyone has what they need, so the bar is empty. Mages get the same for Arcane Intellect, and priests for Divine Spirit: only mana users are suggested.

summary: In a group, Stack Your Buffs suggests each buff only for the people it helps: Thorns on the tank, Arcane Intellect and Divine Spirit on mana users. One click casts it on them.
